added.summary: On a box element, ::before and ::after are real boxes: display (inline by default), sizes, padding, borders, background, position, transforms, transitions and every other property a <div> takes apply to them, with the generated text inside. They cascade under their element's states, attributes and structural selectors, and never count as its children for :nth-child, :empty or sibling combinators. An idle frame still builds nothing. On a text element they stay styled runs of its text.

added.member: UI documents: ::backdrop and ::picker(select) take every box property
added.summary: dialog::backdrop styles a modal's scrim and select::picker(select) its open list with the full box property set: background, opacity, backdrop-filter, filter, padding, borders, radius, box-shadow and the rest. ::picker(select)'s max-height bounds the rows before they scroll.

breaking.change: The two properties that dialog::backdrop { background } and select::picker(select) { max-height } lowered to are gone, with the dialog's `backdrop` and the select's `pickerMaxHeight` document props. The pseudo-elements are now boxes of their own.
